key_insight: MedVTok provides a shared visual language for medical AI, mapping both 2D images and 3D volumes from diverse imaging modalities into one unified token space.
problem_solved: Existing medical visual tokenizers are often specific to an imaging modality or dimensionality, leaving multimodal systems with fragmented representations that are difficult to reuse.
method: Introduce a general-purpose tokenizer for heterogeneous medical imaging inputs.
Map 2D images and 3D volumes into a common visual token space.
Provide a shared representation interface for multimodal patient-condition modeling.
impact: A common tokenizer could simplify medical multimodal pipelines and improve representation reuse across imaging inputs. The supplied abstract is truncated, so architectural details and performance gains cannot be assessed.
visual_elements: Separate 2D image and 3D volume inputs converging into a single MedVTok block.

paper_title: MedVTok: A General-Purpose Medical Visual Tokenizer
paper_authors: Chenglong Ma, Yuanfeng Ji, Junzhi Ning, Jiyao Liu, Yujie Wei
